en.t: Before long, the year turned anew.

units.source_text: 国忌已过，宫中又呈繁华景象，内宴及踏歌等会相继举行。

en.t: The period of national mourning had passed, and the palace once again took on a scene of splendor, with inner banquets, singing-and-dancing festivals, and other gatherings held one after another.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后闻知，但觉可哀。

en.t: When Empress Fujitsubo heard of it, she felt only sorrow.

units.source_text: 她管自勤修梵行，一心一意地希图后世幸福，远离现世，沉思梦想。

en.t: She devoted herself solely to diligent religious practice, single-mindedly hoping for happiness in the world to come, withdrawing from this present life and sinking into quiet contemplation.

units.source_text: 原有的经堂照旧保留着，另在离开正殿稍远之处，西殿的南方，新建一所经堂，天天在那里虔修。

en.t: The original sutra hall was kept as it had been, while another was newly built a little way from the main hall, to the south of the western pavilion, and there she practiced devoutly every day.
